initial.name: list_agents
initial.description: List your entire subagent tree: the root agent and all reachable continuable descendants, including yourself. Rows carry names, descriptions, and status. A descendant's name is its path from the root, such as reviewer/checker. You can message any other agent in the subagent tree. running means it is working; inactive means no turn is executing; it does not indicate task completion, success, or failure. corrupt, unsupported, or unavailable means this row's own descendants could not be read; the row itself is still a member you can message. While you remain active, you will be notified when a direct child finishes; there is no need to keep checking its status. Use send_message to continue the conversation.

initial.name: send_message
initial.description: Send a message to an agent. A working agent receives it at its next step; an idle agent starts a new turn with it. Returns delivery confirmation.

agent.description: The name of another agent in your subagent tree, as shown by list_agents.

message.description: The message to deliver to the agent.

changes.name: team_task_create
changes.description: Create one unowned pending task on the shared Team task board.

description.description: Complete task details and acceptance criteria.

blocked_by.description: Task ids that must complete first.

write_scopes.description: Advisory workspace-relative file or directory prefixes this task expects to modify.

changes.name: team_task_get
changes.description: Read the complete latest value of one shared task before changing or executing it.

changes.name: team_task_list
changes.description: List shared tasks, including readiness, owner, revision, blockers, and write-scope warnings.

owner.description: Optional owner agent name filter; cannot be combined with unowned.

unowned.description: Filter tasks by whether they have no owner; cannot be combined with owner.

limit.description: Number of rows, 1 through 100. Defaults to 50.

changes.name: team_task_update
changes.description: Compare-and-set a shared task action using the latest revision from team_task_get or team_task_list.

expected_revision.description: Current task revision used as the CAS precondition.

write_scopes.description: Replacement advisory write scopes for edit.

owner.description: Agent name of the root or any continuable descendant for root-only reassign; omit to unassign.
